name: Contrail
subtitle: Automatic flight tracking for iPhone
localizedDescription: Contrail scans your calendar for flight bookings and turns them into trackable trips with live status, gate changes, and delay alerts — all imported automatically so you never have to search for a flight number.
versionDescription: First public Contrail release through the official SideLink source.

privacy: Calendars: Scan your calendar to detect flight bookings and import them automatically.
